title: Replace the loops with closures
prompt: Pocket Budget's summary screen needs four values. Fill each blank so that `large` holds the expenses over 50, `titles` holds their titles, `spent` is the total of all amounts, and `biggestFirst` lists every expense from the largest amount to the smallest.
hints: Each of the first three blanks is the name of a collection method from this lesson.
`reduce` takes a starting value and a closure that combines the running total (`$0`) with the next element (`$1`).
`sorted(by:)` asks "should `$0` come before `$1`?". For largest first, the answer is yes when `$0` is bigger.
